front.title: MPEG Media Transport (MMT) Packaging for Media over QUIC

abstract.t: This document specifies the use of MPEG Media Transport (MMT) as a container format for Media over QUIC (MoQ). MMT carries media over broadcast (ATSC 3.0, ARIB STD-B60), multicast, and unicast (QUIC/ WebTransport) networks. This specification defines the mapping of MMT packets to MoQ objects, interaction with Application-Layer FEC, the derivation of MoQ catalogs from MMTP signaling, and compatibility considerations for both ATSC 3.0 and ARIB STD-B60 systems.
